note: GK bank item (subtopic states_capitals): capital of West Bengal is Kolkata; Kolkata was once the capital of British India. Both taught in east_central and bengal_connection (claims c29, c32, c33; NCERT Appendix I and the Government of West Bengal portal).

Kolkata Police Constable (Prelims) 2023 Q27: capital of Chhattisgarh is Raipur (options included Bhopal and Bilaspur). Taught in east_central with the Raipur/Bhopal confusion flagged in an exam_note (claim c07; practice q15).

WBCS (Exe.) Prelims 2017 Q127: capital of the newly formed state of Andhra Pradesh is Amaravati. Taught in special_cases (and flagged in south): NCERT Appendix I still prints Hyderabad, but the Gazette-published Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation (Amendment) Act, 2026 names Amaravati as the new capital, effective 2 June 2024 (claims c35, c36, c38; practice q25, q40).

WBCS (Exe.) Prelims 2024 Q135: the stem states Dehradun is the capital of Uttarakhand (that pair IS taught in north_west, claim c26, practice q09), but the question actually asks what 'dun' signifies — a valley between the Lesser Himalaya and the Shivalik. That landform meaning belongs to the Geography book and is not covered by any source fetched for this chapter, so the item as asked is not taught.
